description: Liorana wears an opaque burgundy-red floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Narrow gold woven knot and geometric borders frame the neckline, straps, sleeves, center skirt and hem. A cream underdress shows at the modest lower walking opening. A dark brown shawl with wide gold patterned edges rests over her forearms. A decorated metal belt has round fittings and a long hanging front end. Small drop earrings, a pendant and ring provide restrained jewelry. Both brown leather shoes show below the hem. No headgear or weapon appears.
